titel: Penne with red pesto and vegetables
stappen: Cook the penne until al dente and keep a cup of the pasta water.
Fry the carrot in the oil for 5 min. Add the onion and garlic and fry for 3 min.
Add the pepper and cherry tomatoes and fry until the tomatoes break down.
Take the pan off the heat. Stir in the pesto, the crème fraîche and a few splashes of pasta water.
Stir in the pasta until the sauce is glossy. Add more pasta water if needed.
tips: Stir in the pesto and crème fraîche off the heat, otherwise the crème fraîche can split.
More vegetables? Courgette, mushrooms or spinach work too.
